answer: Guard Sybil attacks by making each new agent identity a hollow shell until it posts a bond co-signed by a verified backer, whose stake is slashed if the puppet misbehaves. The registry mints a paying identity only after that bond clears, so a farm cannot spawn a thousand puppets from one wallet: each needs a distinct accountable sponsor posting real collateral. That backer is an oasis of trust among anonymous addresses, and the attacker's cost stays linear and pre-paid, since N fakes demand N bonds. Honest operators reach the zenith cheaply.
